name: GA Cubers Park Be Quiet 2026
information:
This competition has **only** Blindfolded and Fewest Moves events and is not suitable for most first-time competitors. If you are interested in competing in regular speedsolving events, you may want to look into [Clocking in Cobb 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ClockinginCobb2026) two weeks before or one of the Atlanta-area weeknight competitions taking place throughout the fall.

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GACubersBigBlindQualifier2026#72008-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.
